annotations.title: Finish uploads and install the files

description: Installs one or more (up to 50) files from startAssetUpload calls; resource packs go through setResourcePack. Files failing a check are returned in rejected with key and error; the rest apply at the next restart.

key.description: key returned by the start call; pass it unchanged.

parts.description: One entry per uploaded piece, in partNumber order.

etag.description: ETag header from that piece's PUT response, quotes included.

partNumber.description: Piece number from the start call, from 1.

uploadId.description: uploadId returned by the start call for this file.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: completeAssetUploads
title: Finish uploads and install the files
